newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks at fresh highs, gains seen limited.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks at fresh highs, gains seen limited.

text.p: MADRID, June 30 (Reuter) 0830 GMT - Madrid stocks started out around fresh highs on Monday helped by a rise on other European bourses, although gains were seen capped around these levels, dealers said.
* General index up 4.04 points, 0.67 percent, to 608.62
* Repsol adds 70 pesetas to 6,330 amid reports that the government may lift the freeze on LPG prices in July. Gas Natural up 260 pesetas to 32,690.
* Endesa up 180 pesetas to 12,350, setting fresh all-time highs again as the market started to eye the autumn privatisation of up to a 33 percent stake, dealers said.
